promises.text: Our state is facing an affordability crisis that’s hitting families especially hard. From rising property taxes and utility bills to healthcare, childcare, and groceries, the cost of living is stretching household budgets thin. We must hold the line on taxes, deliver the promised 50% property tax cut for seniors, and expand relief for working families. I support limiting utility rate hikes, increasing energy production, and investing in rural communities through agriculture, transportation, and small business support. My focus is on fighting for South Jersey to get its fair share—and for government to make life more affordable for everyone.

promises.text: South Jersey is in the grip of an affordability crisis that’s straining household budgets and holding back our economy. From rising property taxes to utility bills, groceries, and healthcare, working families are being squeezed. Tackling this requires real action—capping utility rate hikes, delivering tax relief for seniors, and investing in rural communities. That means supporting family farms, expanding high-speed internet, and growing local businesses. A stronger, more affordable South Jersey starts with a fair economy that works for everyone—not just a few. We must ensure our region gets its fair share and the tools needed to thrive.
